author: Yuri Wong
description:
My method for making pro-sounding tracks: https://musicprosessions.com/the-steal-method

John Wick said it for me:
"People Keep Asking If I'm Back, And I Haven't Really Had An Answer, But Yeah, I'm Thinking I'm Back!"

Equipment used:
Teenage Engineering EP-40 Riddim
WIDI K.O.II Wireless Dongle (powered by the EP!)
Korg Nanokey Studio

I created the song on the EP40, recorded the stems into Logic and completed the track in Logic. All instruments and plugins for the final track were stock Logic, no external effects and instruments used.

00:00 Making Of
04:35 Full Song
title: I'm Back.
